title: Pure Mitsurugi
summary: Pure Mitsurugi Reptile Ritual tribute-advantage build with generic staples. Mitsurugi monsters trigger powerful search and recursion effects whenever they are Tributed, fueling Ritual Summons from the Deck and banishing or board-wiping opponent fields.

summary.title: Starters
points: Mitsurugi Prayers searches a Mitsurugi monster from Deck to hand, and can Tribute a Reptile monster from your hand or field to Special Summon a Mitsurugi from hand or GY.
Mitsurugi no Mikoto, Aramasa searches a Mitsurugi monster from Deck to hand whenever it is Normal Summoned or Tributed.
Mitsurugi no Mikoto, Saji searches a Mitsurugi Spell/Trap from Deck to hand whenever it is Normal Summoned or Tributed.
Mitsurugi no Mikoto, Kusanagi recovers a Mitsurugi card from the GY or banishment whenever it is Normal Summoned or Tributed.
Mitsurugi Ritual performs a Ritual Summon of a Reptile Ritual Monster directly from your Deck by Tributing monsters from hand or field.
Pre-Preparation of Rites searches Mitsurugi Mirror and one of the named Ritual serpents from your Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Mitsurugi Prayers + Aramasa
steps: Activate Mitsurugi Prayers to add Mitsurugi no Mikoto, Saji from your Deck to your hand.
Normal Summon Mitsurugi no Mikoto, Aramasa, using its summon effect to search Ame no Murakumo no Mitsurugi.
Use Prayers' secondary effect to Tribute Aramasa from the field to Special Summon Saji from your hand.
Aramasa triggers on being Tributed to search Mitsurugi no Miko, Wousu, while Saji triggers on summon to search Mitsurugi Ritual from the Deck.
Activate Mitsurugi Ritual, Tributing Saji to Ritual Summon Ame no Murakumo no Mitsurugi, triggering Saji on Tribute to search Mitsurugi Great Purification.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Ame no Murakumo no Mitsurugi destroys all monsters your opponent controls upon Ritual Summon, and negates an opponent's card or effect unless the opponent discards a card.
Futsu no Mitama no Mitsurugi revives a Reptile monster whenever the opponent Special Summons a monster, recycling Tribute bodies.
Mitsurugi no Miko, Wousu Tributes a Reptile from your hand and an opponent's monster to summon itself, removing opposing threats without destruction, and returns to hand when Tributed.
Mitsurugi Sacred Boundary shields your Ritual Monsters from being targeted or destroyed by Extra Deck monsters, and shuffles four Mitsurugi cards from GY to make the opponent Tribute a monster.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Mitsurugi Ritual is the core Ritual Spell that enables Ritual Summons directly from the Deck.
Mitsurugi Mirror can Ritual Summon from the hand or GY, specifically naming the three serpents for Pre-Preparation of Rites synergy.
Mitsurugi Magatama is a Quick-Play Spell that Tributes a Reptile to destroy a card on the field, or performs a Ritual Summon during the opponent's turn.
Mitsurugi Great Purification Tributes a Level 5 or higher Reptile monster to negate an opponent's card or effect and destroy it.
Mitsurugi Tempest Tributes all three Ritual serpents to banish eight cards from the opponent's field or GY face-down.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Clown Crew and Galaxy-Eyes Tachyon hybrid packages are omitted to keep the deck dedicated to pure Reptile Ritual recursion.
